about.title: About Me
about.behindCodeText: I approach software development as an evolving system where architecture decisions must balance maintainability, delivery time, and business requirements. I prioritize modularity (Clean Architecture), explicit error handling, and transparent documentation. I combine technical rigor with strong communication and collaboration skills. I view teamwork as a catalyst for maintaining a high-productivity environment, mitigating technical debt, and accelerating the delivery of high-impact products.
about.fuelText: Mate or coffee are essential in every development session.
about.movementText: Away from the computer you'll find me playing padel or training at the gym.
about.curiosityText: Playing guitar and taking walks are my ways to clear my mind when searching for solutions to complex problems.

aiProjects.title: Latest Projects
aiProjects.subtitle: Real client projects where, working with the atendium platform, I integrated AI agents into their communication channels. My role: requirements gathering, prompt writing, context loading, n8n workflow design, and external platform integrations.

dise-ingenieria.title: Reporting & Publishing Agent — Plásticos Dise
dise-ingenieria.problem: The Dise plastics manufacturing plant generated daily production reports requiring tedious searches for operators. Furthermore, reports had to be uploaded to the Poka platform with specific comments to maintain a log of each batch produced.
dise-ingenieria.solution: Created a workflow enabling access to Dise's database, batch search, retrieving Poka post history, and generating specific pre-defined reports by the operations manager before uploading to Poka with batch-specific comments, speeding up report submission for operators.
roleHighlights: Created the NestJS backend for data formatting and retrieval from Dise.
Designed system instructions with a professional and empathetic tone tailored for operators.
Loaded context: Dise database with detailed batch production logs.
n8n node flow to generate specific reports pre-defined by operations management for Poka upload.
Integrated with Poka API to publish generated reports.
Integrated with Google Sheets to log and store generated reports.

agente-segufer.title: Technical Support & Incident Reporting Agent — Segufer
agente-segufer.problem: Segufer operates vending machines for industrial safety gear. Often these machines experience dispensing issues or operators are unfamiliar with using the machine or safety equipment.
agente-segufer.solution: Configured a support agent resolving user queries and collecting incident reports from human staff. This improved response times for machine/gear usage inquiries and accelerated technical issue handling.
roleHighlights: Troubleshooting-oriented instructions capable of answering product and vending machine usage queries.
n8n workflow to capture human staff incident reports.
Google Sheets integration to record and store generated reports.
Automated Gmail notifications to sales representatives upon purchase intent completion.

agente-ventas-coc.title: Sales Agent — Círculo Odontológico Córdoba
agente-ventas-coc.problem: Círculo Odontológico Córdoba has an extensive service catalog, and sales staff struggled to keep pace with customer inquiry volumes, leading to delayed responses and lost sales opportunities.
agente-ventas-coc.solution: Created a specialized agent answering questions about courses, events, and services, capable of managing pre-registrations and payments by integrating WhatsApp, Google Sheets, and Supabase to automate sales and admin flows.
roleHighlights: Detailed technical instructions with comprehensive service, event, and course data.
Google Sheets API integration for logging customer inquiries and pre-registrations.
Supabase API integration to store courses and campaigns created by COC.
n8n workflows for managing inquiries and pre-registrations.

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: Products designed to solve real problems with scalable architecture.

clientView.problem: Difficulty for people to find trusted professionals (plumbers, electricians, masons) with verified references and proximity.
clientView.solution: Client application (code non-owned). Trades social network that allows exploring nearby services, verifying location, reading/writing reviews, and contacting directly via private chat.
clientView.businessValue: Integrated monetization system where service providers acquire tokens via Mercado Pago to advertise their services within the app.

techView.architecture: Mobile ecosystem connected to a NestJS RESTful API with layered architecture. Secure transaction management for token purchases and real-time communication.
highlights: Integration with Mercado Pago SDK for real-time payment processing.
Geolocation module for efficient filtering by proximity radius.
End-to-end encrypted chat and rating system with weighted calculation.
Role-based authentication system (user, provider, admin).
Real-time push notifications for new service requests and messages.
Geolocation system for efficient filtering by proximity radius.

clientView.problem: Overabundance of padel rackets creates confusion and indecision for players when purchasing, leading to lost sales for sellers.
clientView.solution: Smart virtual assistant that guides the user through key questions about their level and playing style to recommend the ideal racket. Built with AI.
clientView.businessValue: Increases conversion rates by dynamically filtering real store inventory stock.

techView.architecture: Next.js frontend with SEO-optimized Server-Side Rendering (SSR), integrated with AI that helps select products within the merchant's catalog.
highlights: Structured prompts for extracting user preferences and matching product attributes.
Reactive client-side filtering without page reloads.
Lightweight design engineered for fast conversion across web and mobile.

clientView.problem: Scattered information in corporate events and conferences (schedules, speakers) and lack of interaction channels among attendees.
clientView.solution: Client application (code non-owned). Comprehensive platform: Web Dashboard for event organizers to manage schedules and metrics, plus a mobile app for attendees to check agendas and network in real time.
clientView.businessValue: Operational centralization that reduces logistics costs, boosts real-time participation, and fosters interaction among attendees.

techView.architecture: Unified backend architecture serving both the admin Dashboard and attendee app, maintaining sync via WebSockets.
highlights: Instant schedule synchronization and Push notifications.
Real-time analytical panel with attendance and participation metrics.
Room chat system and direct contacts between participants.
End-to-end encrypted chat.
Monolithic architecture for straightforward scaling.
Web admin panel for managing users, events, and metrics.

clientView.problem: Merchants lack transparency regarding payment gateway fees, exact payout dates, and tools to reconcile transactions, taxes, and settlements in a single place.
clientView.solution: Fullstack fintech platform (web console + transactional API) centralizing multichannel payment processing (Debit, Credit, QR), simulating real-time settlement costs, auditing tax withholdings, and monitoring funds lifecycle from checkout to net account payout.
clientView.businessValue: Asynchronous settlement engine powered by BullMQ applying payment-method-specific fee rules (0.6% QR to 6.5% 3-installment credit) with automated 21% VAT calculation, guaranteed transaction idempotency, and configurable early payout options.

techView.architecture: Clean Architecture across both layers. Frontend: Domain → Application (hooks) → Infrastructure (HTTP repos) → Presentation (UI). Backend: decoupled NestJS modules (Merchants, Transactions, Settlements, Queues) with BullMQ async engine and Prisma ORM over PostgreSQL.
highlights: Asynchronous settlement engine with BullMQ: processes and schedules payouts without blocking checkout flows.
Tiered rate rules per payment method: QR 0.6%, Debit 0.8%, Credit 1-pay 1.8%, Credit 3-installments 6.5% (+ early payout penalty).
Real-time settlement simulator broken down by commission, 21% VAT, and exact payout date.
Guaranteed idempotency on every transaction via unique UUID v4 keys.
Multi-merchant manager with instant switching between store branches and independent balances.
POS-style checkout emulator with real-time validation.
API documented with Swagger and containerized with Docker Compose.
